name: Yes or No Confirmation
summary: Ask the client to present a simple confirmation prompt and return the person's explicit yes, no, or canceled outcome to the agent.

invocation.notes: The confirmation prompt is carried by the normal ClientDirective preamble/prompt surface. The client owns presentation and does not receive a remote form description.

outcomes.name: Canceled
outcomes.summary: The person dismissed the confirmation without choosing yes or no.

responseContract.notes: The terminal yes/no/canceled outcome fully expresses the response. No duplicate boolean value is returned.

sourceReferences.note: Defines one semantic directive mapped to one bounded client interaction.
Identified a reusable Yes/No Confirm interaction as the next Client Directive primitive.
